git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Cycle 6 (working-tree, uncommitted) — the synthetic functions.subagent_lifecycle envelope + view + state machine landed via ticket-20260508-130403.md but the close_agent terminal-emit path read fields (message.final_summary / message.finalSummary) that don't exist in the real Codex protocol.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Cycle-6 dev hand-rolled field names without validating against ts-rs-generated TypeScript type definitions or the Codex TUI Rust source. Cycle-6 fixture-based QA passed because the fixture itself carried the hallucinated shape, masking the gap. Production sessions render the merged card without summary text because real protocol never populates those fields.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Three-layer wiring fix using verbatim Codex CLI v0.125.0 protocol type definitions: (1) bridge forwards real field agentsStates on item/completed; (2) mapper reads event.agentsStates[receiverThreadId].message at wait_agent end (mirrors Codex TUI's wait_complete_lines surface point), buffers it, and inherits to close_agent terminal; (3) orchestrator persists subagentLifecycles Map across mapper invocations within a turn so the buffer survives. Cycle-6 hallucinated-field reads deleted entirely (no legacy-fallback path).
